# ADR-3053: A05: Error verbosity configuration for API family 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Verbose errors expose internals to attackers.

## Decision

APIs MUST set a bounded error verbosity configuration for API family 5 (A05-5).

## Consequences

Clients receive opaque correlation IDs.
